pool.text: Castilian troops disembarked and founded a military camp in Santa Cruz de Tenerife.
An English squadron under Admiral Robert Blake defeated a Spanish silver fleet in Santa Cruz.
A British squadron under John Jennings mounted an unsuccessful attack on the island.
Rear-Admiral Horatio Nelson launched an unsuccessful attempt to storm the harbour in Santa Cruz.
King Charles IV granted a Royal Warrant symbolizing victories over naval attacks in Santa Cruz.
An outbreak of cholera-morbid spread throughout Santa Cruz and neighboring municipalities.
The Circulo de Bellas Artes cultural center was founded in Santa Cruz de Tenerife.
The Parque García Sanabria public urban park was inaugurated in Santa Cruz de Tenerife.
A Royal decree ordered that the Canary Islands capital status be shared with Las Palmas.
The historical newspaper En marcha was published in Santa Cruz de Tenerife.
The republican mayor José Carlos Schwartz Hernández was arrested and murdered in Santa Cruz.
A former container tank at the refinery was transformed into Espacio Cultural El Tanque.
A torrential flood took place in Santa Cruz de Tenerife.
The city revitalization plan named Santa Cruz + Viva was launched in the city.
The financial crisis paralyzed the development of Santa Cruz de Tenerife.
The TEA – Tenerife Espacio de las Artes building opened in Santa Cruz.
The Guardian included Santa Cruz de Tenerife in the list of best places to live.
A large part of the Macizo de Anaga was declared a Biosphere Reserve by UNESCO.
The opening part of the movie Jason Bourne was filmed in Santa Cruz de Tenerife.
An international Masonic congress was held in Santa Cruz de Tenerife.
